description:
## 1.10.0 (2026-11-01)

### ✨ New Features

* **nicoid:** Add customizable gestures for closing and restoring tabs, refreshing lists, opening search, jumping to the top or loaded end of a list, and switching tabs.
* **nicoid:** Add MP4 downloads from video menus, long-press dialogs, and the player menu, with selectable video quality.
* **nicoid:** Add a Downloads page showing active, queued, saved, and failed downloads, including progress, file size, and available transfer speed and remaining time.
* **nicoid:** Add an MP4 destination folder setting. Saved MP4 files are intended for external players; the existing cache list remains available separately.
* **nicoid:** Add minimum and maximum view-count filters to search, using snapshot search only when a view-count range is specified. ([#104](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/104))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix crashes, outdated background playback controls, and playback remaining stuck loading after switching apps or changing playback modes. ([#97](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/97))
* **nicoid:** Improve player restoration when returning from popup or background playback. ([#103](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/103))
* **nicoid:** Restore the browsing screen and selected tab correctly after returning from background playback, and allow returning to browsing from the restored normal player.
* **nicoid:** Preserve the transparent background of the Shorts video information overlay. ([#98](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/98))
* **nicoid:** Fix series loading stopping prematurely when an intermediate page contains fewer than 100 videos. ([#99](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/99))
* **nicoid:** Fix uploader ID filtering not being applied consistently to search and ranking results. ([#100](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/100))
* **nicoid:** Fix search tab titles and results failing to update immediately after editing the search terms.
* **nicoid:** Fix Nico Reports pull-to-refresh remaining active after loading finishes.
* **nicoid:** Keep the existing overflow menu open when toggling continuous or shuffle playback, and prevent duplicate menus.
* **nicoid:** Reduce comment disappearance and position changes after additional comments are loaded by preserving active comment state and avoiding unnecessary renderer restarts.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Save continuous and shuffle playback settings separately for each tab. ([#102](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/102))
* **nicoid:** Preserve the playback queue when switching between normal, popup, and background playback. ([#102](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/102))
* **nicoid:** Open new tabs immediately to the right of the current tab and select the tab on the left after closing the current tab.
* **nicoid:** Update the current search tab when changing its search conditions from the toolbar.
* **nicoid:** Improve content-filter editing with separate drafts for each category, input clearing, regular-expression validation, and uploader ID editing. ([#101](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/101))
* **nicoid:** Reduce playback interruptions during transitions between normal, popup, and background playback.
* **nicoid:** Use underline tabs with horizontal swipe navigation in Downloads, keep the Close button at the bottom, and allow failed or canceled entries to be removed by long-pressing.
* **nicoid:** Display cache titles in Downloads and refresh saved entries when MP4 files are deleted outside the app.
* **nicoid:** Refine search range dialog spacing and numeric input behavior.
* **nicoid:** Improve comment timing during rendering delays and reduce contention between comment loading and drawing.
* **nicoid:** Improve resource cleanup and prevent delayed work from updating destroyed screens.
